security_requirements: A2B is a wired in-vehicle bus; physical access to the harness is the primary threat surface.
Node discovery and addressing are controlled by the host through the main node, limiting which nodes can be configured.
Line and power-fault diagnostics support detection of tampering or miswiring of a segment.
Confidentiality / authentication of the audio payload, if required, is an application-layer concern layered above A2B, not part of the transport itself.

extraction_hints: Look for key-management, side-channel, secure-boot sections.
